raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 was delivered twice, at 02:00 and again at 05:00 on 2026-01-18. Its 654 rows are 327 transactions × 2, and the copies are identical except for ingest_ts, so silver_transactions holds 305 duplicated POSTED txn_ids and roughly double the volume for 2026-01-17. Deduplicating raw_transactions on txn_id, keeping the latest ingest_ts, gives the correct data because every other column is the same across copies.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
